API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APITraffic ForwardingGet Zscaler Nodes Details
Get Zscaler Nodes Details
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/vips

Gets a paginated list of the virtual IP addresses (VIPs) available in the Zscaler cloud, including region and data center information. By default, the request gets all public VIPs in the cloud, but you can also include private or all VIPs in the request, if necessary.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
dc
string

Filter based on data center.

region
string

Filter based on region.

page
int32

Specifies the page offset.

Default value: 1
pageSize
int64

Specifies the page size. The default size is 100, but the maximum size is 1000.

Default value: 100
include
string

Possible values: [all, private, public]

Include all, private, or public VIPs in the list.

Default value: public
subcloud
string

Filter based on the subcloud for the VIP. To learn more see, About Subcloud.

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)

string

The country.

The GRE IP addresses.
